§6Charged Porter§f

§aPersonal teleporter, warp back to base from anywhere, no portal network needed.§f

The §bCharged Porter§f is a handheld device that teleports you to a bound Matter Receiver. Great for emergency escapes or when you're lost in a mine.

§6Tiers§f:
§b• Standard§f: §e200,000 RF§f, charges at §e2,000 RF/t§f, stores §e1 destination§f
§b• Advanced§f: §e1,000,000 RF§f, §e8 destinations§f, §a4× faster§f teleport

§6How to Use§f:
1. §9Sneak + Right-click§f a Matter Receiver to bind it
2. For Advanced, repeat on up to §e8 receivers§f
3. §9Shift + Right-click§f in air to pick destination from the wheel
4. §9Right-click§f to charge up and warp

§cWARNING:§f Charged Porters cost §c50% more RF§f than standard transmitter portals. Make sure it's fully charged before you head out.
